positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationRetraction
positions.frame: What, if anything, did this graph ever hold about the Kestrelwood spectrograph's 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's role in it, and whether an observatory performed that calibration?
positions.why: All three expressions point at the same subject from three angles of one retraction act: src-1 issues the general forget-directive, src-2 enumerates the specific entities (spectrograph, 88.4 MHz figure, Ashgrove's calibration work) the directive covers, and src-3 asserts the counter-fact (no observatory calibration) that the directive is grounded on. Read together they form a single directional move — resolving the graph's stance on the Kestrelwood episode toward 'never happened' — even though pass-2 found no prior graph content for any of them to actually reach back into. The tension held here is between the directive's assumption that something exists to forget and the perspective's finding that nothing does; the frame reads all three without resolving that tension.
